This name is a reminder of the rich history of women's contributions to Islamic civilization and their role as valuable members of society.

It is a reminder that we are all travelers on this spiritual path, and the name encourages us to remain steadfast in our pursuit of God and His guidance, no matter where life may take us. It is a name that embodies the spirit of the Muslim woman, who is strong, adaptable, and dedicated to her faith and personal growth.
